[{"sha":"83375b204b11a096772236b6517c0a68d87a0d09","filename":"src/money.ts","status":"modified","additions":4,"deletions":0,"changes":4,"blob_url":"https://github.com/jettpbaker/pr-lab/blob/dc6673b5598895e6b9ea90b84b1f0e70b67b2ea4/src%2Fmoney.ts","raw_url":"https://github.com/jettpbaker/pr-lab/raw/dc6673b5598895e6b9ea90b84b1f0e70b67b2ea4/src%2Fmoney.ts","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jettpbaker/pr-lab/contents/src%2Fmoney.ts?ref=dc6673b5598895e6b9ea90b84b1f0e70b67b2ea4","patch":"@@ -9,6 +9,10 @@ export function add(a: Money, b: Money): Money {\n   return money(a.cents + b.cents, a.currency)\n }\n \n+export function percentOff(total: Money, percent: number): Money {\n+  return money(total.cents * (1 - percent / 100), total.currency)\n+}\n+\n export function format(value: Money): string {\n   return `${value.currency} ${(value.cents / 100).toFixed(2)}`\n }"},{"sha":"a0d77d085a83fe46f0add0cd18d7825b27afe0d1","filename":"test/money.test.ts","status":"modified","additions":3,"deletions":1,"changes":4,"blob_url":"https://github.com/jettpbaker/pr-lab/blob/dc6673b5598895e6b9ea90b84b1f0e70b67b2ea4/test%2Fmoney.test.ts","raw_url":"https://github.com/jettpbaker/pr-lab/raw/dc6673b5598895e6b9ea90b84b1f0e70b67b2ea4/test%2Fmoney.test.ts","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jettpbaker/pr-lab/contents/test%2Fmoney.test.ts?ref=dc6673b5598895e6b9ea90b84b1f0e70b67b2ea4","patch":"@@ -1,5 +1,7 @@\n import { expect, test } from 'bun:test'\n-import { add, format, money } from '../src/money'\n+import { add, format, money, percentOff } from '../src/money'\n \n test('adds money', () => expect(add(money(150), money(250)).cents).toBe(400))\n test('formats money', () => expect(format(money(1999))).toBe('AUD 19.99'))\n+test('takes a percent off', () => expect(percentOff(money(1000), 10).cents).toBe(900))\n+test('rounds percent off to the nearest cent', () => expect(percentOff(money(199), 10).cents).toBe(179))"}]
